set.body: Goal: after the 9/10 hardening spine lands, codify the target-10 expansion as a separate epic rather than mixing speculative semantics into the cleanup. Acceptance: inspect the hardened graphics API; decide scope for typed stats, coordinate systems, facets/panel grids, geom lowerers, and user-facing DSL; create follow-on mote structure with dependencies and acceptance criteria; no implementation is required in this planning gate.
set.title: Graphics: prepare target-10 semantic expansion epic
